checks: Passed: original MW retained; positive finite draws; operational-only baseline; cancelled=0; nondecreasing trajectories; ordered intervals

assumptions.capacity_model: lognormal with partial pooling by stage and operator plus standardized log-acreage; unknown acreage integrated as N(0,1); conditional missing-MW range 0.1–10000; no political size predictor
assumptions.proposed_approval: neutral=0.5; proportional=Trump vote share of all ballots; winner_step=0.75/0.25
assumptions.time_uncertainty: log SD 0.45 per project; common lognormal shock with log SD 0.2
assumptions.ramp: median clip(3*sqrt(target MW/500),1,10) years; log SD .35 and shared schedule shock
assumptions.first_phase: Uniform(0.1,0.3) fraction of target at opening
assumptions.operational_baseline: Beta(8,2) fraction of reported/imputed target; remaining capacity ramps; baseline is also modelled
assumptions.resident_accounting: All county residents receive county operating MW / county population; county residents counted once
assumptions.intensity_denominator: Fixed union of non-cancelled tracked host counties with 2024 population; also report dynamic operating-host denominator
assumptions.structural: Fixed pipeline and county winners; no new announcements, closures, population growth, grid constraint or demand cap
assumptions.intervals: 90% simulation intervals conditional on scenario; not calibrated forecast coverage
